# Mindfulness Center | School of Public Health | Brown University

> The Mindfulness Center at Brown University's School of Public Health is a leading research and education institution advancing evidence-based mindfulness interventions including MBSR and MBCT.

The center conducts rigorous research in mindfulness-based stress reduction and cognitive therapy while offering professional training programs and courses for students, educators, and the general public. Led by internationally recognized researchers, it bridges neuroscience, psychiatry, and public health to advance the science and practice of mindfulness.

## Key Topics

- Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)
- Mindfulness-Based Cognitive Therapy (MBCT)
- Mindfulness research
- Mental health
- Stress reduction
- Teacher training
- Professional development
- Health equity

- Neuroscience

- [Research](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/research): Overview of mindfulness research across neuroscience, epidemiology, and psychiatry at Brown.

## Education & Training Programs

- [Education Overview](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/education): Overview of graduate and undergraduate mindfulness courses and training programs.
- [For Brown Students](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/education/brown-students): Mindfulness courses available to Brown University graduate and undergraduate students.
- [For Aspiring MBSR Teachers](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/education/aspiring-mbsr-teachers): MBSR teacher certification program teaching evidence-based stress reduction techniques.
- [For Aspiring MBCT Teachers](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/education/aspiring-mbct-teachers): MBCT teacher training program integrating mindfulness meditation with cognitive therapy.
- [For Everyone](https://mindfulness.sph.brown.edu/education/everyone): Eight-week mindfulness programs for the general public and stress reduction training.
